Role Title: Applied Scientist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Python

  • Machine Learning

  • Statistics

  • Data Analysis

  • Experimentation

  • Pandas

  • Data Modeling

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required; your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is part of an open Data Scientist project, with a strong emphasis on clear written and verbal communication.

Scope of Work:

  • Design and execute statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets.

  • Develop and validate machine learning models for various business or research objectives.

  • Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define experimentation frameworks and analyze outcomes.

  • Document methodology, findings, and recommendations with a focus on clarity and precision.

  • Review peer contributions and provide high-quality feedback to support knowledge sharing.

  • Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports as part of the project deliverables.

  • Evaluate AI model outputs on statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative problems.

  • Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions.

  • Identify flawed methodology, statistical errors, and weak quantitative reasoning.

  • Provide clear, structured feedback that improves model capability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least one year at a top company (tech, finance, or research).

  • Expertise in Python, including proficiency with libraries such as Pandas and scikit-learn (sklearn).

  • Demonstrated experience in applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning.

  • Proven ability to develop, tune, and evaluate machine learning models in practical settings.

  • Strong data modeling skills and experience managing structured and unstructured data.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for clear technical documentation.

  • Experience collaborating on open or cross-functional data science projects is a plus.

  • Advanced academic background or hands-on work in data science, applied mathematics, or related fields.

About the Role

Our client is an innovative AI-driven retail security firm currently experiencing 10x growth. As they scale from individual retailers to massive enterprise clients with 100+ locations, they are seeking a Founding Applied Scientist to build their core AI capabilities from the ground up.

This is not a "pure research" role. You will be a hands-on builder owning the full model development lifecycle. You’ll be responsible for everything from data collection strategy and quality assessment to training, inference optimization, and shipping production-quality code. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will collaborate with a distributed engineering team to deliver computer vision solutions that have an immediate impact on retail safety and operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Model Development: Take full ownership of the model lifecycle, including production training, optimization, and inference deployment.

  • Bridge Research & Engineering: Write substantial, production-ready code (Python) to ensure CV models are successfully deployed via cross-functional engineering teams.

  • Strategic Data Planning: Design and implement data collection and quality assessment frameworks to improve model accuracy in real-world retail environments.

  • Technical Communication: Present complex technical findings and AI roadmaps to both engineering teams and executive leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, ML Engineering, or Computer Vision roles.

  • Proven Track Record: You have shipped customer-facing products and have deep experience with real-world CV applications (e.g., YOLO or similar architectures), rather than just academic projects.

  • Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Python with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Academic Background: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision.

  • Collaborative Spirit: Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and collaborating with distributed teams across time zones (specifically Turkey-based engineering).

This is a remote position.

Two notes for you:

  • Irrational Labs is based in San Francisco. But you can be based anywhere in the U.S. This is a remote U.S. company with 2x a year in-person gatherings.
  • This role could be part-time or full-time. If part-time, we bring people on for projects (2 or 4 days a week).

    • About us
    Irrational Labsis a leading behavioral economics research and design firm. We were co-founded by famed author/professor Dan Ariely and behavioral scientist Kristen Berman.
    The Irrational Labs team works with the very top companies to design and implement systems and products that change behavior. Our work spans from driving customer adoption of digital experiences to creating ground-up innovations that leverage key psychologies. We are experts in how and why people make decisions and guide top companies in applying this knowledge to their top problems.

    Who is this role best for?This position is perfect for someone trained in behavioral science and someone with client management skills. At current, we are not hiring junior people. This person has experience applying behavioral science concepts/ideas in a real-world environment (read: must have industry/work experience in behavioral science)

    Examples of questions we answer include:

  • How can we increase the conversion rate for job sites that promote adult education?
  • How can we increase the productivity of meetings?
  • How can we prevent the spread of misinformation?
  • How can we drive adherence to healthy behaviors within a healthcare company?We work directly with PMs, designers, and marketers at tech companies. This means you will need some understanding of how a tech company works and be a skilled communicator of behavioral insights in order to get on their roadmap.

    You would build relationships with senior stakeholders, form a joint working team, and take the client through the Behavioral Design process. Throughout the process, you will consult with Irrational Lab’s core team of behavioral scientists and advisors including Kristen Berman and Dan Ariely.

    By being a part of this team, the person will learn key insights about human behavior that could be used in the future across domains. You’ll learn how Irrational Labs thinks about product design. You’ll be exposed to projects, workshops, and new ways to approach problems.


    Requirements

    Skills/experience required:

  • 3+ years of professional experience, ideally at a behavioral consultancy shop or as a behavioral scientist at a company.
  • Track record of driving projects end-to-end, preferably client-facing projects
  • Ability to be the main counterpart to senior decision-makers at companies. Highly effective oral communicator.
  • Extremely persuasive and high level written communication skills (Read: You can make and edit clean slides)
  • Ability to design experiments, write study questions and glean insights from datasets and experiments
  • Ability to mock up medium-fidelity designs that represent our proposals (in ppt, figma or sketch)
  • Preferred: Applied behavioral science experience within industry or consultancy.
  • Not required: Knowledge of R or a Ph.D.

    Benefits

    Perks:

  • Exposure. You’ll get exposure to all projects Irrational Labs takes on. Given we’re a small team you’ll get to play a significant role in strategic decision making.
  • Impact. Every project we do is with the goal of making a real impact on people’s lives. And we measure it.
  • Humor. We are fun and funny, at least we think we are [awkward pause].

    About Upstart

    At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

    As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

    We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

    If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

    The Team

    Upstart’s Servicing team supports borrowers after loan origination and works to improve outcomes for investors and borrowers. The team is building data-informed approaches across areas such as collections, loan assistance, payment experiences, and borrower communications, with a meaningful opportunity to apply machine learning to problems that have often been addressed manually.

    As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Servicing team, you will build predictive and causal models and translate their outputs into decisions that improve how loans are serviced. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and Servicing and Collections Operations to evaluate interventions and shape data-informed approaches to payment plans, loan modifications, communications, and autopay.

    How you’ll make an impact

    • Develop and evaluate machine-learning models that predict borrower repayment behavior and other servicing outcomes.
    • Apply causal inference and experimentation to measure the impact of servicing interventions, including loan modifications and payment assistance.
    • Translate model predictions and treatment-effect estimates into practical decision algorithms and actions.
    • Partner with Product and Engineering on payment experiences, autopay, and borrower communications, and with Servicing and Collections Operations on collections strategy and agent-performance insights.
    • Identify and develop machine-learning opportunities in servicing areas that have historically relied on manual optimization.
    • Explain analytical choices, tradeoffs, and findings to technical and non-technical partners to inform high-stakes operational and product decisions.

    Minimum Qualifications

    • Graduate degree in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
    • Experience applying causal inference methods and experimentation to real-world decisions in an applied science or data science context.
    • Applied statistics, probability, and experimental-design expertise used to build or evaluate models or interventions.
    • Production-quality coding experience in Python, including data manipulation and algorithm implementation.
    • 2+ years of experience conducting machine-learning, statistical-modeling, or applied quantitative research in an academic or industry setting.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • PhD in a quantitative field.
    • Experience with payment products or payment experiences, such as autopay, recurring payments, or payment plans.
    • Experience with causal machine-learning methods or treatment-effect modeling.
    • Experience with supervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering, especially with large or complex datasets.
    • Experience taking work from exploratory analysis and experimentation through production model development while maintaining analytical rigor and model reliability.
    • Ability to translate broad servicing or business problems into structured research questions and communicate complex findings as actionable recommendations.

    Position location

    This role is available in the following locations: Remote — United States.

    Travel requirements

    As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S or Canada (outside of Quebec) but are expected to spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites and in-person meetings. The onsite cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

    Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

    At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

    This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

    Role Overview

    Lumen is seeking highly technical, product-minded Senior Lead Applied AI Scientists to design, build, deploy, and continuously improve production-scale AI solutions of all varieties: agents, generative, ML, etc. In this role, you will partner with business, product, engineering, and technology leaders to translate high-value opportunities into AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business impact. 

    You will combine deep expertise in AI and machine learning with strong software engineering, experimentation, and product delivery skills. The ideal candidate is a hands-on practitioner who can rapidly prototype, evaluate, and scale AI systems while helping stakeholders navigate technical and business tradeoffs. 

    What You'll Do

    • Design, build, and optimize AI solutions from concept through production deployment.
    • Partner with business and product teams to identify opportunities, define success metrics, and validate value through rapid experimentation.
    • Develop advanced AI systems leveraging machine learning, generative AI, retrieval, predictive modeling, and agentic architectures.
    • Define evaluation frameworks and continuously improve quality, reliability, safety, performance, and cost.
    • Partner with Engineering to deliver scalable, production-ready solutions using MLOps and LLMOps best practices.
    • Contribute reusable frameworks, evaluation assets, and technical standards that accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.
    • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance on complex AI initiatives.

    Required Qualifications

    • Seven Plus years of experience in applied AI, machine learning, or data science, including production AI deployments.
    • Proven track record of delivering AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
    • Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, predictive analytics, and modern AI techniques.
    • Hands-on experience building LLM, RAG, agentic, and machine learning solutions.
    • Strong experience with AI evaluation, model performance optimization, responsible AI, and production monitoring.
    • Proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, MLflow, or similar technologies.
    • Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, cloud AI platforms, APIs, and software engineering best practices.
    • Strong product mindset, problem-solving skills, and ability to communicate complex concepts with technical and business stakeholders.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
    • One plus years of experience building agent based solutions.
    • Experience operating enterprise-scale AI solutions in regulated or security-sensitive environments.
    • Experience leading complex, cross-functional AI initiatives.
    • Contributions to AI research, patents, publications, or open-source projects.

    About the team

    Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

    The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15–20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

    This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals.

    About the role

    • Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.
    • Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).
    • Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.
    • Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.
    • Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.
    • Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.

    Description

    Role Summary

    Vi Engage puts predictive models into the daily operations of the largest health systems and health plans in the country — driving care navigation, specialty capture, and the workflows that follow from them. Applied Data Scientists are the people who turn a new customer into a running deployment on Vi's platform.

    You will own 3–5 enterprise healthcare accounts at a time, end to end. For each one you are the data expert in the room: you design the pilot that proves value, integrate the customer's data (tokens, claims, EHR, marketing) into Vi's platform and build the automated pipelines that train, score, and deliver insights on a schedule. You stay the technical owner through operations and drive accounts to “autopilot”.

    This is a hands-on-keyboard role with direct exposure to stakeholders. You are expected to sit with customer teams with expertise in analytics, marketing, and clinical operations to understand what KPIs they need to move, and how to leverage Vi’s capabilities to make it a reality. What you learn in the field becomes the product: you will spot the patterns across your accounts and turn them into the requirements that shape Vi's roadmap.

    What You'll Own

    • Data integration. Own the pipeline between customer data systems and Vi's data platform — ingestion, mapping, quality, and the judgment calls about what the data can and cannot support.
    • Pilot design. Design studies that tie model performance to a business outcome the customer will underwrite. Power, controls, confounders, and a metric that survives scrutiny from a sophisticated internal analytics team.
    • Automated production pipelines. Build per-customer pipelines that use Vi’s ML capabilities to train, score, and deliver insights without manual intervention — and keep them running.
    • Customer ownership. Be the technical authority across onboarding and ongoing operations, including the ad-hoc data and reporting questions that come with a live account.
    • Product leverage. Identify what's common across customers and synthesize it into high-leverage requirements for the platform, so the next deployment is faster than the last.

    What We're Looking For

    • Experimental design you can defend. You have designed and run studies where the result mattered commercially — and you can explain, to a skeptical stakeholder, why the design supports the conclusion. This is the capability we screen hardest on.
    • Real data science depth. You can explain how a model works, evaluate it honestly, and say what it is not good for. You know when a simpler approach is the right answer.
    • Python and ML engineering. Fluent in Python and the working stack — pandas, sklearn, airflow. You ship code to production that automates client deliverables.
    • PySpark at scale. You have built distributed data and ML pipelines on Spark against large, messy datasets.
    • Client-facing command. You can run a working session with clinical, IT, and analytics leaders at a major health system or health plan on your own — translating between their business problem and what the data will actually support, and holding the line when the answer isn't what they hoped. You will occasionally travel onsite with clients.
    • Ownership instinct. You treat your accounts as yours: you find the problem before the customer does and you fix it.

    Nice To Have

    • Healthcare or life sciences domain knowledge — claims, EHR, HL7/FHIR, lab data, or population health analytics
    • Experience designing and optimizing the targeting of marketing and engagement campaigns
    • AWS data infrastructure: S3, Glue, EMR, MWAA, SageMaker
    • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare compliance and data governance frameworks
    • Experience taking a product from its first customer deployment to a repeatable one

    What This Role Is Not

    This is an applied, in-production role. It is not a research position — the work is measured by deployments that run and outcomes customers can point to, not by novelty. And it is not a delivery or engagement management role: you will be architecting and writing the pipelines yourself, not coordinating someone else who does.
